# Synthetic shared baseline for command guard tests, version 1.
# Mirrors the repository's Git and GitHub shared-baseline rules as of
# 2026-09-20 so combined-policy verdicts stay deterministic.

# rewriting remote git history
(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+push[^;&|]*[[:space:]](-f|--force)([[:space:]]|$)
(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+push[^;&|]*[[:space:]]\+[A-Za-z0-9._/-]

# deleting remote branches/tags
(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+push[^;&|]*[[:space:]](--delete|-d)([[:space:]]|$)
(^|[;&|[:space:]])git[[:space:]]+push[^;&|]*[[:space:]]:[A-Za-z0-9._/-]

# GitHub CLI: irreversible or account-level destruction
(^|[;&|[:space:]])gh[[:space:]]+repo[[:space:]]+delete([[:space:]]|$)
(^|[;&|[:space:]])gh[[:space:]]+release[[:space:]]+delete([[:space:]]|$)
(^|[;&|[:space:]])gh[[:space:]]+api[[:space:]][^;&|]*(-X|--method)(=|[[:space:]]+)(DELETE|delete)
(^|[;&|[:space:]])gh[[:space:]]+auth[[:space:]]+token([[:space:]]|$)
